timeline.tweet: Everyone wish me luck, this is the first time I've babysat over night and I'm kinda freaking out about it.
Okay thanks! You made me feel a lot less anxious.
I really don’t feel like doing Christmas. I’m depressed and just want to stay in bed.

I was diagnosed with depression in 7th grade and kept it a secret because I was afraid people would judge me. Then senior year I was diagnosed as bipolar and told some people and they all basically stopped talking to me...
